formal_specification.domain: Static Rust module and nominal type exports. There is no runtime mathematical input or admission operation in this file.

invariant_argument: All noncomment source items were inspected and mechanically restricted to public child-module declarations, public use declarations and lint-only module-inception annotations. No initializer, macro-generated item, unsafe block, function or mutable state is present.

failure_paths.runtime: This file has no runtime operation, argument conversion, allocation, indexing, recursion or error recovery. Importing its namespace does not execute the providers functions.

trust_boundary.scope: This is compiler/API-wiring verification, not a Lean theorem, Rust/MIR refinement, underlying category proof or source-origin attestation.
